items.lede: Meta’s board feared that its CEO’s departure could disrupt the company’s AI ambitions. A new stock agreement gives him financial incentives to stay put.
items.title: Mark Zuckerberg Agrees to Stay in California Despite Billionaires’ Tax Ballot Measure

items.lede: Chief executive agrees to remain in California for eight years even if state brings in one-off 5% wealth tax Meta has struck a deal with Mark Zuckerberg to help him foot a possible California wealth tax targeting billionaires. The social media company behind Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp revealed on Wednesday night that the arrangement would keep its chief executive living
items.title: Meta strikes deal with Mark Zuckerberg to help him foot billionaire tax bill

items.lede: The Meta boss had said he would exit the state over a wealth tax that has not yet come into force.
items.title: Zuckerberg wins Meta deal to help him foot bill for possible California billionaire tax

items.lede: A newly launched stock class being offered was partially engineered to help Meta founder and CEO Mark Zuckerberg pay the "billionaire's tax," should the measure be voted into law.
items.title: Mark Zuckerberg’s creative plan to pay California’s proposed billionaire tax without losing control of Meta
